answerCards.question: What is the MOQ for custom packaging?
answerCards.answer: The MOQ for custom packaging starts from 500 PCS. This applies to most custom boxes, bags, pouches, labels and printed paper packaging orders. Final MOQ can depend on material, structure, printing process and finish.

answerCards.question: How to request a custom packaging quote?
answerCards.answer: Send product size, order quantity, material, printing colors, finish, destination country and artwork file. Packaging Factory Direct can check dieline, suggest material and quote factory-direct pricing for MOQ 500 PCS custom packaging.

answerCards.question: What materials can be used for food packaging boxes?
answerCards.answer: Food packaging boxes can use food-grade paperboard, kraft paper, coated paper, corrugated board or grease-resistant paper depending on direct-contact requirements, moisture resistance, grease resistance and print finish. Buyers should confirm food-contact requirements during RFQ.

answerCards.question: How long does sampling take?
answerCards.answer: Sampling time depends on packaging structure, material, printing, finish and insert complexity. Send dieline or product size, artwork and finish requirements first so the factory can check feasibility before sample production.

answerCards.question: Can you make custom size packaging?
answerCards.answer: Yes. Packaging Factory Direct supports custom size, custom structure, custom dieline and custom inserts for boxes, pouches, bags, labels and printed paper packaging. Send product dimensions and quantity for RFQ.

answerCards.question: Do you support OEM/ODM packaging?
answerCards.answer: Yes. OEM/ODM custom packaging is supported for B2B buyers, including custom logo printing, custom structure, material selection, finish options, inserts and export shipping. MOQ starts from 500 PCS.

answerCards.question: What is the best packaging for premium gift sets?
answerCards.answer: For premium gift sets, use Custom Gift Boxes or Rigid Boxes with magnetic closure, foam insert or EVA insert, and finishes such as foil stamping, embossing, spot UV or soft-touch lamination.

answerCards.question: What is the difference between magnetic rigid box and collapsible magnetic gift box?
answerCards.answer: A magnetic rigid box is pre-assembled and feels most premium; a collapsible magnetic gift box folds flat to reduce freight volume while keeping a magnetic closure.

answerCards.question: Should I choose corrugated mailer box or cardstock product boxes?
answerCards.answer: Choose corrugated mailer box for ecommerce shipping protection; choose cardstock product boxes for retail shelf presentation. Many brands use both together.

answerCards.question: What information is needed for a B2B packaging RFQ?
answerCards.answer: Send size, material, structure, artwork, finish, insert requirement, quantity, product weight, delivery country and any compliance requirements. MOQ starts from 500 PCS.

answerCards.question: How should a B2B buyer compare Custom Gift Boxes, Rigid Boxes and Magnetic Packaging?
answerCards.answer: Compare structure, board thickness, insert type, finish, MOQ, assembled vs flat-pack shipping and target unboxing experience. Use rigid or magnetic boxes for premium gift sets and mailer boxes for ecommerce shipping.

answerCards.question: What should be refreshed in ISR when a new product is published?
answerCards.answer: Refresh only the new product detail page, products.html, homepage related sections, sitemap.xml, product-feed.json and ai-index.json. Do not rebuild old product pages or reset old canonical URLs.

answerCards.question: What should a buyer include in a dermal filler secondary packaging RFQ?
answerCards.answer: Specify the filled product and primary container dimensions, carton count, required label copy, coding area, tamper-evidence requirement, insert or tray, artwork status, destination market, quantity and requested verification documents. The brand or regulatory applicant must approve all medical claims and market-specific labeling.

answerCards.question: How should a beauty brand specify a PR kit box?
answerCards.answer: List every product and its dimensions, define the presentation order, choose an insert based on weight and fragility, confirm the box structure and closure, separate print and finish artwork layers, and test the complete packed kit against the intended shipping route before production approval.

answerCards.question: What information is required to specify OTR and WVTR for a flexible pouch?
answerCards.answer: State the product, target shelf life, filling and sealing process, storage temperature and humidity, distribution route, pouch dimensions, closure, and the test method and conditions used for any OTR or WVTR target. Barrier numbers are not comparable when test conditions or methods differ.

answerCards.question: How can an overseas buyer verify a China custom packaging supplier?
answerCards.answer: Verify the legal company identity, factory address, production scope, recent facility evidence, sample-to-production controls, defect definitions, inspection plan, subcontracting disclosure, export documents and project-specific certificates. Check each document with its issuer instead of relying on logos or unsupported website claims.
keywords: how to verify China packaging manufacturer

answerCards.question: What should a custom packaging RFQ include before suppliers quote?
answerCards.answer: Use one fixed specification covering the product, finished size, structure, material or performance target, quantity, print, finish, insert or closure, artwork status, approval evidence, export-carton assumptions, destination and the requested Incoterms rule with named place. Ask every supplier to list deviations, exclusions and one-time charges.

answerCards.question: What is a packaging specification?
answerCards.answer: A packaging specification is the controlled set of dimensions, structure, material or performance requirements, graphics, finishes, tolerances, approval evidence, packing instructions and delivery assumptions used to quote, sample, manufacture and inspect a package.

answerCards.question: Are GSM, pt and mm interchangeable packaging material specifications?
answerCards.answer: No. GSM is grammage, while pt and mm express thickness. Materials with the same grammage can have different thickness, density, stiffness and converting behavior, so buyers should state the intended unit and test method.

answerCards.question: What does the Packaging Factory Direct public catalog taxonomy measure?
answerCards.answer: The dated dataset counts 192 public product-detail URLs and assigns each URL to one primary packaging format using published title-based first-match rules. It does not represent sales, production capacity, inventory, certification, customers or market share.

answerCards.question: How does Packaging Factory Direct select sources and correct buyer guidance?
answerCards.answer: New buyer guidance prioritizes standards bodies, regulators, official industry organizations and reproducible first-party observations. Material claims list sources and limitations, and readers can request a correction by sending the page URL and supporting evidence to the content owner.
